## Read in Downloaded GEO counts:

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(Orpheus)
seurat_obj = readRDS("../../20240529.snTC.integrated.rpca.RDS")
```

Take TauFisher clustering:

```{r}
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters")
```

Add ZT information to Seurat object:

```{r}
table(seurat_obj$day, seurat_obj$orig.ident)
#So ZT00 is from day 'two', all other time points are from day 1

matches <- stringr::str_match(seurat_obj$orig.ident , "ZT(\\d+)\\w+$")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
seurat_obj$ZT = ZT
```

## Now do Methods of Moments analysis (ORPHEUS)

```{r}
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in unique(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters)){
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))
# cluster = subset(seurat_obj, subset = seurat_clusters == cell_type)
# vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(cluster@assays$RNA$counts)
# means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(cluster@assays$RNA$counts)
# plot(log(means), log(vars))

# tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 10)
tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input_tmm(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 2, normalize = F)

#Get Pseudobulk and variance for each gene for each subject
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
rm_rows = which((rowSums(var_mat > 0 ) < 2) | (rowSums(pb_mat > 0) < 2))
if(!purrr::is_empty(rm_rows)){
  pb_mat = pb_mat[-rm_rows, ]
  var_mat = var_mat[-rm_rows, ]
}


tmp2 = extract_clstr_prep_input_tmm(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 2, normalize = T)

pb_mat2 = tmp2[[1]]
var_mat2 = tmp2[[2]]
rm_rows2 = which((rowSums(var_mat2 > 0) < 2) | (rowSums(pb_mat2 > 0) < 2))
if(!purrr::is_empty(rm_rows2)){
  pb_mat2 = pb_mat2[-rm_rows2, ]
  var_mat2 = var_mat2[-rm_rows2, ]
}


matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

if(length(unique(diff(ZT))) != 2 || length(unique(ZT)) < 6){
  print("Cell does not have time points suitable for analysis")
  next
}

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat)
pb_cycling2 = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat2)

pb_cycling_tmm_filt = filter(pb_cycling2, as.numeric(p_statistic)<0.05)
pb_cycling_raw_filt = filter(pb_cycling, as.numeric(p_statistic)<0.05)

ggvenn::ggvenn(list("sig raw" = pb_cycling_raw_filt$Gene_Symbols,
                    "sig tmm" = pb_cycling_tmm_filt$Gene_Symbols))
merged_pb_cycling = merge(pb_cycling_tmm_filt, pb_cycling_raw_filt, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("_tmm", "_raw"))
plot(as.numeric(merged_pb_cycling$acrophase_bulk_tmm), as.numeric(merged_pb_cycling$acrophase_bulk_raw))
# var_cyclers = var_cycling(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat)
  
#Get info to run var_cycling_fix_acro, where phases ARE fixed
all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols)
phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
phase_pb2 = pb_cycling2 %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
# circ_genes = filter(pb_cycling, as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(Gene_Symbols) %>% unname %>% unlist


#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

#Run cosinor regression on variance data, where phases are fixed.
var_cyclers_fixed = var_cycling_fix_acro(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, phase_pb)
var_cyclers_fixed2 = var_cycling_fix_acro(ZT, var_mat2, pb_mat2, phase_pb2)
ggvenn::ggvenn(list("sig RC" = var_cyclers_fixed$Gene_Symbols[as.numeric(var_cyclers_fixed$double_freq_p_statistic) < 0.05],
                    "sig tmm" = var_cyclers_fixed2$Gene_Symbols[as.numeric(var_cyclers_fixed2$double_freq_p_statistic) < 0.05]))


var_cyclers = var_cycling(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, phase_pb)
var_cyclers2 = var_cycling(ZT, var_mat2, pb_mat2, phase_pb2)

var_cyclers_raw_filt = filter(var_cyclers, as.numeric(double_freq_p_statistic)<0.05)
var_cyclers_tmm_filt = filter(var_cyclers2, as.numeric(double_freq_p_statistic)<0.05)
ggvenn::ggvenn(list("sig raw" = var_cyclers_raw_filt$Gene_Symbols,
                    "sig tmm" = var_cyclers_tmm_filt$Gene_Symbols))

merged_var_cyclers = merge(var_cyclers_raw_filt, var_cyclers_tmm_filt, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("_raw", "_tmm"))
plot(as.numeric(merged_var_cyclers$double_freq_acrophase_raw), as.numeric(merged_var_cyclers$double_freq_acrophase_tmm))


# plot_rhythms(ZT, var_mat2, pb_mat2, plot_me = c("AT5G38430", "AT3G01500", "AT3G26740", "AT2G05100"), time_units = "hrs")

#### cosinor results 1 ###
input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
     left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols") %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC,  everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC > full_model_AIC)

hist(input_cos$acrodiff, main = paste(cell_type, "raw counts, free cosinor acrodiffs"))

  # Calculate phi parameters
phi_cos = input_cos %>%
  apply(., 1, function(row) {
    Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
  }) %>%
  t %>%
  as.data.frame
colnames(phi_cos) = c("G_pred", "Ac_pred", "theta", "phi")
print(paste0("cosinor fixed acro: ", sum(!is.nan(phi_cos$phi)), "/",nrow(input_cos), " phi's not nan"  ))

phi = calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = 0.5)

output_cos_raw = merge(phi_cos, input_cos, by = 0)


plot_df = merge(input_cos, phi_cos, by = 0)
```

```{r}
cos_phis_raw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[3]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][3])
  current_df
}))

cos_phis_raw_filt = filter(cos_phis_raw,!is.nan(phi))
table(cos_phis_raw_filt$Source)

cos_phis_tmm_filt = filter(cos_phis_tmm, !is.nan(phi))
table(cos_phis_tmm_filt$Source)
```
